fields.title: 📖 Shirk by calling upon the dead and the absent
fields.body:
🖋️ **Ibn Taymiyyah** explained:

> ***“Ibn Taymiyyah said: Whoever calls upon creatures among the dead and the absent and seeks help from them is an innovator in the Dīn and commits Shirk with the Lord of the worlds.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Duʿāʾ is ʿIbādah (worship). When it is given to the dead or the absent, something of Allah’s right is transferred to creatures.

immutable.source: 📝 Ibn Taymiyyah, Majmūʿ al-Fatāwā, Bd. 1, S. 312, Abschnitt: Dīn al-Islām Mabnī ʿalā Aṣlayn.
